title: Descriptive Statistics You Can Defend
evidence: README or technical note explaining the result
Executable code/notebooks when the task includes analysis or implementation
Reflection notes answering the task questions
AI disclosure entry when AI materially influenced the work
acceptanceCriteria: The write-up names the unit and the population the table actually covers.
Outliers are discussed, not deleted by default.
No p-values or 'significant' language in this task.
A chart has a title that is a sentence, not a variable name.
